head_html:
<style>
:root {
    --navari-paper: #F7F8F6;
    --navari-ink: #15191D;
    --navari-muted: #667078;

    --navari-red: #D92D20;
    --navari-ocean: #176B87;
    --navari-orange: #E98A3A;
    --navari-cloud: #EEF1F2;

    --navari-font-heading:
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "SF Pro Display",
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;

    --navari-font-body:
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "SF Pro Text",
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;

    --navari-radius-sm: 12px;
    --navari-radius-md: 18px;
    --navari-radius-lg: 24px;
    --navari-radius-xl: 32px;

    --navari-shadow-soft:
        0 8px 30px rgba(21, 25, 29, 0.06);

    --navari-shadow-hover:
        0 16px 45px rgba(21, 25, 29, 0.10);

    --navari-content-width: 1200px;
    --navari-section-padding: 96px;
    --navari-mobile-padding: 24px;

    --navari-transition:
        300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: var(--navari-paper);
    color: var(--navari-ink);
    font-family: var(--navari-font-body);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

img {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
}

a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

button {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

button,
.navari-button,
.navari-nav-link {
    min-height: 48px;
}

.navari-card {
    border-radius: var(--navari-radius-md);
    transition:
        transform var(--navari-transition),
        box-shadow var(--navari-transition),
        border-color var(--navari-transition);
}

.navari-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: var(--navari-shadow-hover);
}

.navari-reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
    transition:
        opacity 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
        transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.navari-reveal.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    html {
        scroll-behavior: auto;
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    }

    .navari-reveal {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    :root {
        --navari-section-padding: 72px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    :root {
        --navari-section-padding: 64px;
        --navari-mobile-padding: 20px;
    }

    .navari-card {
        border-radius: var(--navari-radius-md);
    }

    .navari-card:hover {
        transform: none;
        box-shadow: var(--navari-shadow-soft);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
    :root {
        --navari-mobile-padding: 16px;
    }
}
</style>

<style>
@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .navari-desktop-nav {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .navari-mobile-menu-toggle {
        display: inline-flex !important;
    }
}
</style>


<style id="navari-tablet-navigation">
@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .navari-desktop-nav + a {
        display: none !important;
    }
}
</style>

<style id="navari-active-navigation">
.navari-nav-link-active {
    color: var(--navari-red) !important;
}
</style>

<style id="navari-contact-button">
.navari-contact-link {
    transition:
        background-color 200ms ease,
        color 200ms ease,
        transform 200ms ease;
}

.navari-contact-link:hover,
.navari-contact-link:focus-visible,
.navari-contact-link:active {
    background-color: var(--navari-red) !important;
    color: var(--navari-paper) !important;
}

.navari-contact-link:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.25);
    outline-offset: 3px;
}
</style>

<style id="navari-mobile-contact-button">
@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .navari-contact-link {
        background-color: var(--navari-red) !important;
        color: var(--navari-paper) !important;
    }
}
</style>

<style id="navari-refinements">
/* Content remains available if scripts fail or are disabled. */
.navari-reveal { opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; }
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,[tabindex]:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #176B87 !important; outline-offset:5px; }
.navari-skip { position:fixed; top:8px; left:16px; transform:translateY(-180%); z-index:9999; padding:14px 22px; background:#15191D; color:white; border-radius:8px; }
.navari-skip:focus { transform:none; }
section { scroll-margin-top:100px; }
.navari-integration-grid a:hover { border-color:#D92D20 !important; }
@media(max-width:1024px) { .navari-desktop-nav { display:none !important; } .navari-mobile-menu-toggle { display:inline-flex !important; } .navari-desktop-nav + a { display:none !important; } }
@media(max-width:767px) { .navari-integration-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr !important; } }
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { html {scroll-behavior:auto !important;} }
</style>
